name: steward
description: Steward monorepo: GPUI Fast host with NSH Rust and TSX applications.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @steward/plugin-calendar build && pnpm --filter @steward/plugin-clipboard-history build && pnpm --filter @steward/plugin-ui-showcase build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @steward/plugin-calendar typecheck && pnpm --filter @steward/plugin-clipboard-history typecheck && pnpm --filter @steward/plugin-ui-showcase typecheck
